text:
morgan: Quick check — audit window next Friday (requested window 2024-12-12). Need confirmation who owns the KMS evidence handoff for the log-ingest path (ingest -> kafka -> s3 -> audit pipeline). Also need the latest retention policy PR and whether reviewers cleared it. @ria @sam @juan

ria: I can own evidence for the s3/audit staging side. PR #4287 contains the retention policy changes. Sam — you good to own keystore/KMS attestation artifacts?

sam: Yep I can take KMS attestation. One dependency: eng-infra needs to cut a staging key with HSM flags enabled. @juan can you confirm timeline for that provisioning?

juan: Staging HSM key should be provisioned by Thu (11:59pm PT). I raised infra/ops#993 to enable HSM flags; infra says QA gating currently blocks merge. ETA Wed EOD for the merge unless a post-merge tweak is needed.

morgan: Thanks. Auditor asked for the retention snippet and kms mapping so they can pre-validate. Can someone paste the relevant config showing `log_retention_days` and `kms_key_id` mapping?

ria: Sure — snippet from staging config:
```json
{
  "audit": {
    "log_retention_days": 365,
    "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef01",
    "bucket": "redwood-audit-staging"
  }
}
```

auditor-liaison: That looks fine. One follow-up: we need rotation proof (key versions) for the last 90 days included in the export. Can you add a `rotation_history` export to the audit artifact? Auditor wants timestamps + key version ids.

sam: I can add that. Will open a PR today to append `rotation_history` to the export manifest. Also pinging @devops-bot to trigger the artifact job once PR merges.

devops-bot: artifact-build triggered: job 5582. Estimated ~20m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/5582

sam: PR #4299 opened — adds rotation_history export and a small schema change. Assigning @ria for review.

ria: Reviewing now. Small nit: `rotation_history` field should be an array of objects with keys `version_id` and `rotated_at` (ISO8601). I'll push a tiny rename then approve.

morgan: Great. One last operational ask — can we get a concise owners matrix for the pre-audit checklist in this thread? Example format: KMS attestation -> sam; log ingest pipeline -> juan; retention policy -> ria; evidence export -> sam. Reply with any adjustments so I can populate the audit tracker.

juan: That mapping looks correct to me. Please add eng-sre on-call for the deployment window: @oncall-eng-sre. They'll handle any rollout fallbacks.

ria: Approved PR and merged to staging. retention policy live on staging. :rocket:

sam: HSM key provisioned and smoke passed. devops-bot: please create release tag for audit staging `audit-2024-12-08`.

devops-bot: release created: tag audit-2024-12-08, artifacts: https://ci.redwood.com/artifacts/audit-2024-12-08

auditor-liaison: Thanks — I'll package the evidence (configs, rotation_history, artifact links) and send to the auditor team tonight. If anything changes, ping me here. :thumbsup:
